recoveryAuthorizationBypass.description: Contrast run with recoveryRequiresAuthorization=false. Shows why the shipped config keeps the flag true: a signed older recovery image would then boot, and a power cut at commit-version would resume it as an ordinary image.

invariants.statement: The board-observed current image boots under the shipped config.
The unsigned image is rejected before execution.
The corrupt image is rejected before execution.
The wrong-product image (v8, newer than minimumVersion) is rejected by product binding, not by version: a newer version alone is not an upgrade.
The signed older image is rejected by protected rollback state.
The recovery image routes to separately authorized recovery rather than booting, i.e. it is not a signature-only rollback bypass.
